links.outcome: Physician-rated accuracy and usefulness of RAG-grounded LLM templates versus human-generated templates
links.effect: LLM templates grounded in clinical guidelines scored higher on average for accuracy and usefulness than human templates; BERTScore showed high textual similarity. No non-RAG LLM comparator, no numbers in abstract.
links.quote: The LLM templates scored higher on average for both accuracy and usefulness when compared to human-generated templates.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applied to clinical guidelines as a safeguard/practice against hallucinations and outdated information in LLMs, evaluated by physicians.
